ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

   B. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
